name: Korfez Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
summary: Körfez Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. develops and markets real estate projects in Turkey. The company is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey. Körfez Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Kuveyt Türk Katilim Bankasi A.S.
